name: Early-access or hardship claim without supporting evidence
description: Request to release retirement funds before the normal age on grounds such as ill health, hardship or emigration where the supporting evidence is thin, inconsistent or unverifiable.
fp: Genuine early-release grounds exist and members may struggle to supply full documentation.

links.name: Early-access or hardship claim without supporting evidence
links.ctx: Early release claim based on medical or residency grounds with documents that cannot be verified, then paid to a third-party account.
